layers.chooseTeam: Choose a team to show layers

feeds.heading: Team and service-type calendar feeds
feeds.help: Subscribe in Google, Apple or Outlook Calendar. Your calendar app decides how often it refreshes (often every few hours), so a last-minute change may not appear at once. Access is checked on every refresh.

scopeOption.team: A team (people on it, or teams I schedule)

blockoutForm.endExclusiveHint: End date is exclusive: a one-day blockout ends at the following local midnight.
blockoutForm.ambiguousLabel: If the clock repeats this time
blockoutForm.skippedHint: A time skipped when the clock moves forward is rejected.
blockoutForm.monthlySkipHint: Monthly dates missing from a month are skipped.

blockoutForm.overlaps_other: {{count}} existing commitment times overlap. Their answers will stay unchanged.

responses.noTimes: Time not set yet — shown by service date

batch.intro: Review every position and time before submitting
batch.changed: This request changed. Refresh the review before submitting.
batch.loadFailed: Could not prepare the response review.
batch.saveFailed: The reviewed responses were not saved.

responses.withdrawExplain: Your scheduler will be told. Your other positions on this plan stay as they are. To serve in this position again, a scheduler has to ask you again.
responses.askScheduler: Ask a scheduler if you can serve in this position after all.

failure.stale: This position changed since you opened it. It has been refreshed — review it and answer again.
failure.unavailable: This position is no longer available to you.
failure.network: Your answer may not have been saved. Check your connection and try again.

notifications.description: Every time you're scheduled, reminded, or someone answers a request you sent.
notifications.emptyDescription: When you're scheduled onto a plan it lands here, and on your phone if you've allowed notifications.
